name: A0_LENGTH
description: Number of entries in the first end-screen score/name table.

name: A1_LENGTH
description: Number of entries in the second end-screen score/name table.

name: A2_LENGTH
description: Number of entries in the third end-screen score/name table.

name: ACT_ADD_AMMO
description: Add `var1` ammunition to weapon slot `var2`; returns the resulting ammunition count.

name: ACT_ADD_ITEM
description: Add an item with the NVID in `var1` to a unit item list.

name: act_addammo
description: Action opcode that adds ammunition; `var1` is the number of rounds to add and the action returns the resulting ammunition amount.

name: ACT_ATTACK
description: Attack the target specified by `var1`.

name: act_attack
description: Action opcode for attacking a monster; the legacy comment specifies the monster pointer in `var1`.

name: ACT_BACKUP_COMMAND
description: Push the currently executing command onto the action stack.

name: ACT_BUILD_UNIT
description: Build a unit with the NVID in `var1`.

name: act_buildunit
description: Action opcode for building a unit; `var1` supplies the unit NVID.

name: ACT_CHANGE_ANIMATION
description: Set the unit animation to `var1`.

name: ACT_CHANGE_COOR
description: Set the sprite coordinates using `var1` (X), `var2` (Y) and `var3` (Z).

name: ACT_CHANGE_DIRECTION
description: Set the unit direction to `var1`.

name: ACT_CHANGE_VID
description: Change the sprite VID to `var1`; `var2` optionally changes animation, with -1 leaving it unchanged.

name: act_changeaction
description: Action opcode that changes the unit action; `var1` supplies the action code and `var2` the direction.

name: act_changecoor
description: Action opcode that changes the unit X and Y coordinates using `var1` and `var2`.

name: act_changecoor_z
description: Action opcode that changes the unit Z coordinate using `var1`.

name: ACT_CLASH_ENGINE
description: Ram the engine referenced by `var1`.

name: act_clash_engine
description: Action opcode for ramming or colliding with another train engine; `var1` identifies that engine.

name: ACT_CLEAR_COMMAND
description: Stop the currently executing command.

name: ACT_CLEAR_STACK
description: Clear the action stack.

name: act_clearstack
description: Action opcode that clears the unit action-command stack.

name: act_close
description: Action opcode used to close an object or interactive unit.

name: ACT_COOR_ATTACK
description: Fire a single shot at the map coordinates in `var1`/`var2`.

name: ACT_CYCLE_STACK
description: Loop the command stack to the command index specified by `var1`.

name: act_cycleaction
description: Action opcode that loops the unit action-command stack.

name: ACT_DAMAGE
description: Apply damage from `var1`; `var2` identifies the unit that caused it. A return value of 1 indicates that repair is not needed.

name: act_damage
description: Legacy action opcode associated with unit damage. The original source comment notes that its behavior may be changed, so its payload semantics are not documented more specifically.

name: act_death
description: Action opcode for the unit death action.

name: ACT_DELETE_ALL_ITEM
description: Remove all items from a unit item list.

name: ACT_DELETE_ITEM
description: Remove an item with the NVID in `var1` from a unit item list.

name: ACT_DESTROY_UNIT
description: Destroy an object with NVID `var1` at coordinates `var2`/`var3`.

name: ACT_FIRST_ENGINE
description: Return the first engine in a train.

name: act_firstengine
description: Action opcode that returns the first engine in a train consist.

name: ACT_FLAGMAN_TRIGGER
description: Pause command-stack execution while Flagman distance exceeds the thresholds in `var1`/`var2`/`var3`.

name: ACT_FORCELINK_ENGINE
description: Force-link the engine referenced by `var1` to reconnect a split train.

name: act_forcelinkengine
description: Action opcode that links a detached engine to a consist; `var1` identifies the engine to attach.

name: ACT_GET_AMMO
description: Return ammunition for the weapon slot specified by `var1`.

name: ACT_GET_ANIMATION
description: Return the current animation.

name: ACT_GET_ARMY
description: Return the army number.

name: ACT_GET_BATTLE_RANGE
description: Return the unit battle range, accounting for linked objects.

name: ACT_GET_BEHAVE
description: Return the current behaviour mode.

name: ACT_GET_COMMAND
description: Return the command currently being executed (`COM_*`).

name: ACT_GET_GOAL
description: Action opcode used with `Action()` and `AddCommand()`; the opcode selects the `get goal` action.

name: ACT_GET_HP
description: Return the unit hit points.

name: ACT_GET_ITEM
description: Return the item stored in the slot specified by `var1`.

name: ACT_GET_LINK
description: Return the sprite linked to this sprite.

name: ACT_GET_PERCENT_HP
description: Return unit hit points as a percentage.

name: ACT_GET_SPEED
description: Return the current speed.

name: ACT_GET_TEXT
description: Return the string associated with an `STEXT` sprite.

name: ACT_GET_TIMER
description: Action opcode that returns the unit timer value.

name: ACT_GET_UPLINK
description: Return the parent sprite to which this sprite is linked.

name: ACT_GET_ZSPEED
description: Return the current Z speed.

name: act_getaction
description: Action opcode that returns the unit current action code.

name: act_getammo
description: Action opcode that returns the unit ammunition amount.

name: act_getarmy
description: Action opcode that returns the unit army number.

name: act_getbehave
description: Action opcode that returns the current unit behavior code.

name: act_gethp
description: Action opcode that returns the unit hit-point value.

name: act_getlink
description: Action opcode that returns the engine linked to the current unit.

name: act_getpercenthp
description: Action opcode that returns the unit hit points as a percentage.

name: act_getstate
description: Action opcode that returns the current unit state.

name: act_getuplink
description: Action opcode that returns the upstream linked engine.

name: act_getweaponrange
description: Action opcode that returns a unit weapon range, taking a linked unit into account.

name: ACT_HAVE_ITEM
description: Test whether the unit has an item with the NVID in `var1`.

name: ACT_IN_TRAIN
description: Return whether the engine specified by `var1` is present in the train.

name: act_intrain
description: Action opcode that checks whether an engine is present in the train consist; `var1` is the engine handle to search for.

name: ACT_IS_FIRST
description: Return whether the wagon is the first wagon in its train.

name: ACT_IS_TRAIN
description: Return whether the sprite is a locomotive/train engine.

name: ACT_LAST_ENGINE
description: Return the last engine in a train.

name: act_lastengine
description: Action opcode that returns the last engine in a train consist.

name: ACT_LINK_ENGINE
description: Link the engine referenced by `var1` to the train.

name: act_linkengine
description: Action opcode that links a train engine; `var1` is the engine to attach.

name: ACT_LOGIC_RUN
description: Run `LogicRun` with the value in `var1` and the current sprite.

name: act_menudisable
description: Menu-button state opcode that disables the button.

name: act_menustanddown
description: Menu-button state opcode for the normal, unpressed button.

name: act_menustandup
description: Menu-button state opcode for the pressed button.

name: ACT_MOVE
description: Move to the map coordinates in `var1` and `var2`.

name: act_move
description: Action opcode for movement; `var1` supplies the target X coordinate and `var2` supplies the target Y coordinate.

name: ACT_MOVE_TO
description: Move to the sprite target referenced by `var1`.

name: ACT_NEXT_COMMAND
description: Animation-completion callback invoked when a sprite finishes playing an animation.

name: ACT_NEXT_ENGINE
description: Return the next engine in a train.

name: act_nextengine
description: Action opcode that returns the next engine in a train consist.

name: ACT_NONE
description: No-op command; performs no action.

name: act_open
description: Action opcode used to open an object or interactive unit.

name: ACT_PATH_BLOCK
description: Path-blocked movement callback; `var1` and `var2` contain the last X/Y movement deltas.

name: ACT_PATH_GROUND
description: Ground-intersection movement callback; `var1` is the new Z and `var2` is the ground Z.

name: ACT_PATH_LIMIT
description: Movement callback invoked when an object leaves the map boundaries.

name: ACT_PATROL
description: Patrol to the map point in `var1`/`var2` and return.

name: ACT_PAUSE
description: Wait for `var1` plus a random amount up to `var2` milliseconds.

name: ACT_PLAY_SFX
description: Play the sound effect identified by `var1`.

name: ACT_RANDOM
description: Perform a random idle action, such as a lazy animation, a head turn, or no action.

name: ACT_REPAIR
description: Fully restore hit points and rebuild a destroyed turret.

name: act_repair
description: Action opcode for restoring hit points, including repairing a damaged or destroyed tower.

name: ACT_RESTORE
description: Restore sprite-specific state from the stream referenced by `var1`.

name: act_restore
description: Action opcode that restores the sprite information from the stream pointer supplied in `var1`.

name: ACT_ROTATE
description: Turn toward the direction specified by `var1`.

name: act_salut
description: Action opcode that plays the unit salute action.

name: ACT_SAVE
description: Save the sprite-specific state to the stream referenced by `var1`.

name: ACT_SET_ARMY
description: Set the army number to `var1`.

name: ACT_SET_BEHAVE
description: Set the behaviour mode to `var1`.

name: ACT_SET_DEATH_TIMER
description: Set the time until the sprite dies; 999999 disables the death timer.

name: ACT_SET_FILE
description: Set the filename associated with the sprite.

name: ACT_SET_HP
description: Set hit points using `var1`; when `var1` is zero, `var2` is interpreted as a percentage of maximum HP.

name: ACT_SET_INVISIBLE
description: Set visibility using `var1` (1 hides the object; 0 makes it visible).

name: ACT_SET_LINK
description: Link the sprite referenced by `var1` to this sprite.

name: ACT_SET_SPEED
description: Set speed to `var1`.

name: ACT_SET_TEXT
description: Set the string associated with an `STEXT` sprite.

name: ACT_SET_TEXT_COUNT
description: Set the number of characters currently displayed.

name: ACT_SET_TIMER
description: Action opcode that sets the unit timer value using the supplied timer value.

name: ACT_SET_UPLINK
description: Unlink this sprite from its parent.

name: ACT_SET_ZSPEED
description: Set Z speed to `var1`.

name: act_setarmy
description: Action opcode that assigns the unit to an army; `var1` is the target army number.

name: act_setbehave
description: Action opcode that sets the unit behavior; `var1` is the new behavior code.

name: act_setstate
description: Action opcode that sets the unit state; `var1` is the new state value.

name: act_stand
description: Action opcode that places the unit in its standing/default action state.

name: act_stand_open
description: Action opcode for the standing-open state.

name: ACT_STOP
description: Stop executing commands; a non-zero `var1` requests an immediate stop.

name: act_stop
description: Action opcode that stops the unit; a non-zero `var1` requests an immediate stop.

name: ACT_STOP_STACK
description: Stop execution of subsequent action-stack commands.

name: ACT_TRAIN_BEHAVE
description: Set the train behaviour mode using a `TRAINBEHAVE_*` value in `var1`.

name: act_train_behave
description: Action opcode that sets a train consist behavior mode; `var1` is a `TRAINBEHAVE_*` value.

name: ACT_UNDO_INSERT
description: Map-editor undo operation that restores a unit to the screen without recreating the underlying object.

name: ACT_UNDO_REMOVE
description: Map-editor undo operation that removes a unit from the screen without deleting the underlying object.
